details.title: A Short History of Nearly Everything
details.author: Bill Bryson

reading.review: Bill Bryson turns geology, chemistry, paleontology, and cosmology into an irresistible tour packed with eccentric discoverers and memorable analogies. Ideal for listening on walks — you come away marveling at how much we know and how recently we learned it.

note.note-text: Clair Patterson's decades-long effort to measure the age of the Earth accurately using lead isotopes in meteorites.
